auditory_anchor_script.title: THE AUDITORY ANCHOR — Pixel & Ink Studio Team Voice Note

transcript.speaker: Sophia
transcript.text: Hi team. / This is Sophia. // It's Tuesday, / and I want to talk about the brief / for La Esquina Bakery.
grammar_highlights: Gr2 possessive 'the brief for La Esquina'

transcript.speaker: Sophia
transcript.text: So, / the client is a family bakery. / They want warm colors. / I like brown and cream. / Andrés agrees. / The logo is a round seal.

transcript.speaker: Sophia
transcript.text: The font is Playfair Display — / a classic serif. / No sans-serif for this project. // Right, Laura?

transcript.speaker: Laura
transcript.text: Right. // And for Andrés, / a quick color-wheel refresher. / The color wheel has twelve colors. / Warm colors are red, orange, yellow. / Cool colors are blue, green, purple.

transcript.speaker: Laura
transcript.text: Remember: / warm colors feel friendly, / cool colors feel calm. // For a bakery? / Warm. / For a bank? / Cool. / And always check the CMYK values before printing.

transcript.speaker: Sophia

auditory_anchor_script.full_text_for_tts: Hi team. This is Sophia. It's Tuesday, and I want to talk about the brief for La Esquina Bakery. So, the client is a family bakery. They want warm colors. I like brown and cream. Andrés agrees. The logo is a round seal. The font is Playfair Display — a classic serif. No sans-serif for this project. Right, Laura? Right. And for Andrés, a quick color-wheel refresher. The color wheel has twelve colors. Warm colors are red, orange, yellow. Cool colors are blue, green, purple. Remember: warm colors feel friendly, cool colors feel calm. For a bakery? Warm. For a bank? Cool. And always check the CMYK values before printing. Perfect. Andrés, open the canvas in Illustrator. Save a layer for the logo. A simple logo is the best logo. Thanks, team. Talk tomorrow.

archetypes_integrated.policy: ALL 6 archetypes A-F are documented with full PRE/WHILE/POST. Instructor picks ONE flow per S4 block; full menu documented for flexibility across cohorts.

archetype_A_micro_skills.name: Micro-Skills Foundation
archetype_A_micro_skills.when_it_works: When A1.1 learners struggle with decoding (fast speech, linked sounds); first listening experience in the program.
archetype_A_micro_skills.fit_for_A1_1: Highest — ideal warmup archetype for G1.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Listen to these 5 Survival Words. Repeat. Feel the stress. (*Escucha estas 5 palabras clave. Repite. Siente el acento.*)
activities.activity_A1_faulty_echo: Instructor says 'warm' → learners repeat. Then instructor says '*warn*' (wrong) → learners must NOT repeat — catch the error.
activities.predictive_question: What will Sophia talk about? Bakery / Bank / Both?

activities.instruction_bilingual: Three listens. Different micro-skill each time. (*Tres escuchas. Diferente micro-skill cada vez.*)

listen_1_gist.task: Circle ONE topic: (a) menu design, (b) logo + color, (c) office supplies

listen_2_stressed_syllable.task: Mark the stressed syllable in these words as you hear them: TEAM, BRIEF, RE-FRESH-ER, CA-LI-GRA-PHY, DIS-PLAY
listen_2_stressed_syllable.note: Write one dot above the stressed vowel.

listen_3_break_the_flow.task: Break this chunk into words: 'warmcolorsarered' → warm | colors | are | red

activities.instruction_bilingual: In pairs, rebuild chunk 5 from your notes. (*En parejas, reconstruye chunk 5 con tus notas.*)
activities.reflection_prompt: Which sound was hardest? Which word did you miss?
activities.teacher_move: Re-play chunk 5 once more for validation.

archetype_B_phase_based.name: Phase-Based Framework (Pre/While/Post)
archetype_B_phase_based.when_it_works: When group needs predictable structure; default-safe archetype.

activities.phase: PRE-LISTENING — Mind Map + Bottleneck Vocab (10 min)
activities.instruction_bilingual: Brainstorm: what words do you expect in a studio voice note about color? (*Brainstorm: ¿qué palabras esperas en un audio sobre color?*)
activities.mind_map_structure: Center = 'Pixel & Ink Voice Note'; branches = Colors, Shapes, Tools, Clients

activities.instruction_bilingual: Listen twice. Fill the template. (*Escucha dos veces. Llena la plantilla.*)
activities.hypothesis_verification: Did your brainstorm words appear? Circle the ones that did.

activities.instruction_bilingual: In pairs, rebuild what Sophia said in 3 sentences. What did Laura add? (*En parejas, reconstruye en 3 oraciones. ¿Qué agregó Laura?*)

archetype_C_tblt_listening.name: TBLT Listening (Task-Based)
archetype_C_tblt_listening.when_it_works: When listening serves a decision (which palette? which client?); integrates with Speaking/Writing.

activities.instruction_bilingual: TASK: You are a new designer. After listening, you must choose the right palette for 3 new clients. (*TAREA: Eres nueva diseñadora. Después de escuchar, elige la paleta correcta para 3 clientes nuevos.*)

activities.phase: WHILE-LISTENING — Information Extraction for Task (25 min)
activities.instruction_bilingual: Listen twice. Fill the rule Laura teaches. Then apply it to 3 new clients. (*Escucha dos veces. Llena la regla que Laura enseña. Aplícala a 3 clientes nuevos.*)
activities.rule_extraction: Warm colors = [feeling: _________] → fit for [business types: _________]. Cool colors = [feeling: _________] → fit for [business types: _________].
activities.rule_answer: Warm = friendly → bakery, family, food. Cool = calm → bank, tech, clinic.

new_clients_to_classify.justification_frame: A barber shop can use _________ colors.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Share your decisions. Use: 'I chose _____ because _____.' (*Comparte tus decisiones. Usa: 'Elegí _____ porque _____.'*)
activities.presentation_frame: My client is _________. The palette is _________. _________ colors feel _________. This is perfect for _________.

archetype_D_bloom_progression.name: Bloom Progression (Cognitive Scaling)
archetype_D_bloom_progression.when_it_works: When same audio can serve multiple cognitive levels; when instructor wants to scale demand.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Three tasks today: REMEMBER facts → UNDERSTAND summary → APPLY the rule. (*Tres tareas: RECUERDA hechos → COMPRENDE resumen → APLICA la regla.*)
activities.cognitive_preparation: Which is easier for you: remembering details or applying a rule? Discuss 30 sec.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Three listens, three levels. (*Tres escuchas, tres niveles.*)

items.q: How many colors on the wheel?

level_2_understand.model_answer: Sophia confirms warm colors for La Esquina Bakery. Laura teaches the color wheel.

level_3_apply.type: Apply the warm/cool rule to a new case
level_3_apply.case: A client wants a design for a children's toy store. Which palette? Why?
level_3_apply.expected_reasoning: Warm colors are friendly. A toy store is happy and playful. Choose warm (red, yellow, orange).

activities.instruction_bilingual: Rate each level 1-5. Which was easiest? Hardest? Why? (*Puntúa cada nivel 1-5. ¿Cuál fue más fácil? ¿Más difícil? ¿Por qué?*)

archetype_E_advanced_techniques.name: Advanced Techniques (Shadowing + Dictogloss + Predictive)
archetype_E_advanced_techniques.when_it_works: When prosody, memory, anticipation matter; when basic comprehension is already solid.
archetype_E_advanced_techniques.fit_for_A1_1: Stretch — must chunk small; great for pronunciation transfer to PM-2.8.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Today we train the ear AND the mouth. Shadowing = repeat with 1-2 word delay. (*Hoy entrenamos oído Y boca. Shadowing = repetir con retraso de 1-2 palabras.*)
activities.demo: Instructor models shadowing on Chunk 1 (21 words).

activities.instruction_bilingual: Two techniques. Two passes each. (*Dos técnicas. Dos pasadas cada una.*)

shadowing_activity.pass_1_rhythm: Shadow Chunk 1 only. Keep rhythm. Don't worry about accuracy.
shadowing_activity.pass_2_intonation: Shadow Chunk 1 again. Focus on WHERE Sophia's voice goes UP and DOWN.
shadowing_activity.pass_3_liaison: Shadow Chunk 2. Focus on linked sounds: 'the_logo_is', 'brown_and_cream'.
shadowing_activity.self_record: Record your shadowing on phone. Compare with original.

predictive_listening_activity.procedure: Instructor pauses audio at discourse markers. Class predicts next phrase.

pause_points.before: and I want to talk about...
pause_points.predict: the brief / the project / the colors?

activities.instruction_bilingual: Play your shadowing recording. Compare to original. What matched? What didn't? (*Reproduce tu shadowing. Compara. ¿Qué coincidió? ¿Qué no?*)
self_rubric: □ Rhythm matched (stressed syllables in right place)

archetype_F_multimedia_production.name: Multimedia Production (Audio → Creative Output)
archetype_F_multimedia_production.when_it_works: When class has phone/laptop access; when creative synthesis reinforces content.
archetype_F_multimedia_production.fit_for_A1_1: Stretch + recommended for MGV specifically (design students value multimedia).
archetype_F_multimedia_production.production_selected: Interview Simulation — classmates 'interview Sophia' about the brief

activities.instruction_bilingual: After listening, ONE student will BE Sophia. Classmates interview her. (*Después de escuchar, UN estudiante SERÁ Sophia. Los compañeros la entrevistan.*)

activities.phase: WHILE-LISTENING — Extract for Character Preparation (20 min)
activities.instruction_bilingual: Listen twice. Take notes to BE Sophia. (*Escucha dos veces. Toma notas para SER Sophia.*)
character_notes_template: My client this week is: ___________ (La Esquina Bakery)

activities.instruction_bilingual: 'Sophia' volunteer sits front. Class asks 6 questions. (*'Sophia' voluntaria adelante. Clase hace 6 preguntas.*)
sample_questions_pre_prepared: Why did you choose warm colors?
